Placemaker.Landfill.Name: Landfill
Placemaker.Recipe.Landfill.Description: A terraformed waste mound with a working face, gas wells and a haul road — or a capped hill, compost yard, recycling centre or fly-tip.
Placemaker.Landfill.style.Tooltip: Active tip, a finished capped hill, a compost yard, a recycling centre or an illegal dump.
Placemaker.Landfill.moundHeight.Tooltip: Height of the waste mound. Sides are kept near 1 in 3, so small sites get lower mounds. Permanent.
Placemaker.Landfill.moundSize.Tooltip: How much of the site the mound covers; the rest is the toe band with the haul road and lagoon.
Placemaker.Landfill.fill.Tooltip: How much waste lies about: on the face, in the bays, in the dumps.
Placemaker.Landfill.workingFace.Tooltip: The open flank where waste is tipped and compacted, cut into the side facing the gate.
Placemaker.Landfill.coverPiles.Tooltip: Soil piles beside the face for the daily cover.
Placemaker.Landfill.litterFences.Tooltip: Portable screens round the face that catch blowing litter.
Placemaker.Landfill.windrows.Tooltip: Long parallel compost rows on the pad.
Placemaker.Landfill.skips.Tooltip: Recycling yard: public drop-off skips along the drive-through loop.
Placemaker.Landfill.gasVents.Tooltip: Landfill-gas wells in a grid on the finished part of the mound.
Placemaker.Landfill.summitPath.Tooltip: A footpath that spirals up the mound to benches and a viewpoint at the top.
Placemaker.Landfill.meadow.Tooltip: Low bushes on the cap. No trees on the mound: roots would breach the cap.
Placemaker.Landfill.toeTrees.Tooltip: A ring of trees round the foot of the mound.
Placemaker.Landfill.leachatePond.Tooltip: A fenced, lined lagoon at the lowest free spot of the toe.
Placemaker.Landfill.fence.Tooltip: A sound fence, none, or a broken one with missing panels.
Placemaker.Landfill.screenTrees.Tooltip: A belt of trees just inside the fence.
Placemaker.Landfill.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain texture under the face, piles and dumps. Permanent.
Placemaker.Landfill.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's terrain textures (1–4) to paint with.
Placemaker.Landfill.grime.Tooltip: Dirt and puddle decals per 100 m², gathered round the waste and on the roads.
Placemaker.Landfill.shopLayout.Tooltip: A continuous band along the street, or separate shop pads.
Placemaker.Landfill.shopDepth.Tooltip: How deep the zoned band reaches into the area (whole 8 m cells).
Placemaker.Landfill.Issue.MoundTooSmall: The site is too small or narrow for a mound; it was planned flat.
Placemaker.AddOn.SkipRow.Name: Skip row
Placemaker.AddOn.SkipRow.where.Tooltip: Along a straight stretch of the outline, or freestanding in the open.
